kv4.1:1.7: Hañci n' atthi Arahato gihisaññojanaṃ no vata re vattabbe
kv4.1:2.3: Nanu Arahato gihisaññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhamman ti?
kv4.1:2.5: Hañci Arahato gihisaññojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.1:3.3: Atthi koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antaṃ karotīti?
kv4.1:3.5: Hañci n' atthi koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antaṃ karoti, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.1:4.3: Nanu Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca --
kv4.1:4.4: "Atthi nu kho bho Gotama koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass' antaṃ karotīti"?
kv4.1:4.5: N' atthi kho Vaccha koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass' antaṃ karotīti."
kv4.1:5.3: Arahā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, methunaṃ dhammaṃ uppādeyya, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyya, kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyya, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyya, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyya, ajeḷakaṃ paṭigaṇheyya, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ paṭigaṇheyya, hatthigavassavaḷavaṃ paṭigaṇheyya, tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaḷaṃ paṭigaṇheyya, pitavaṇṭavālamolikaṃ dhāreyya, odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni dhāreyya, yāvajīvaṃ agāriyabhūto assāti?
kv4.1:6.4: Nanu Yaso kulaputto, Uttiyo gahapati, Setu mānavo gihissa byañjanena arahattaṃ pattā ti?
kv4.1:6.6: Hañci Yaso kulaputto, Uttiyo gahapati, Setu mānavo gihissa byañjanena arahattaṃ pattā, tena vata re vattabbe
